headline: Singapore Exchange Queries Listed Agribusinesses Over Indonesian Haze Links
summary: SGX RegCo has issued formal queries to listed agribusiness companies, requesting disclosures on any links to corporate entities served legal notices under Singapore's transboundary haze pollution laws.
why: Singapore Exchange regulation sets strict ESG compliance standards; agribusiness exposure to illegal land clearing carries regulatory and reputational risk.

impacts.name: Agribusiness
impacts.why: Regulatory inquiries into haze culpability raise compliance liabilities for plantation operators.
